name: gitea-get-engine-lang
prompt: Add a function `CountUsersInactiveSince(ctx context.Context, since timeutil.TimeStamp) (int64, error)` in services/cron/inactive_users.go that counts the rows of the `user` table whose `last_login_unix` is before `since`. Run the count on the database session the context already carries when the caller is inside a transaction, and otherwise on a new session bound to the context. Keep it small.
